lines.text: Many learners say: I arrived to school late.
Better: I arrived at school late.
At! We arrived at the station.

native.hook: arrive 뒤엔 to 말고 at을 써요!
native.tip: 한국어 “~에 도착하다”의 “에”를 to로 옮기기 쉬워요. 영어는 arrive at! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “arrived at school.”
native.caption: “I arrived to school late.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “학교에 도착했다”의 “에”를 to로 옮기면 틀려요. 영어는 arrive at을 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I arrived at school late.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: After arrive, use at, not to. Say “I arrived at school late.”
en.caption: Do you say “I arrived to school late” in English? 😅 After arrive, use at, not to. “I arrived at school late” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
